answer: Because the atlas lockup is enforced by the sparrow escrow, the karst audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large farm therefore freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants pay once per identity. The bond is locked for 10 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. That is 39 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
